name: The Engine, System by System
description: The Build 42 engine explained system by system: what each part does, where it lives in the code, which side runs it, and what a mod can reach.

groups.name: In the Game
groups.description: What players see and feel: stats and moodles, weather, fire, water and power, building, fishing and trapping, sound, and stashes.

groups.name: Under the Hood
groups.description: The machinery behind it: animation, input, physics, networking, anti-cheat, and saves.
